name: Astribot S1
summary: A humanoid upper body on a wheeled base from Shenzhen's Astribot, a team with roots in Tencent's Robotics X lab. S1's arms are unusually fast — the company demonstrated end-effector speeds around 10 m/s — and its 2024 videos showed fluid household tasks such as pouring wine, folding clothes and flipping sandwiches, largely via teleoperated data and learned policies.
notable: Very high arm speed (~10 m/s end-effector) for a humanoid
